name: Idle Finance
rootCause: The DeFi protocol Idle Finance tweeted that after investigation, the estimated exposure of the Euler Finance vulnerability to the protocol Yield Tranches was $5.6628 million, and the estimated exposure of Best Yield vaults was about $5.3271 million, for a total of about $10.99 million.
